source.title: Call for Applicants - WEC Members (August 2018)
source.content:
The WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) is seeking qualified members to help them with their mission!

**What does the WEC do?**
The WEC's role is to ensure that all the procedures followed by the WCA Staff and External Staff abide by its Code of Ethics, and to perform independent investigations if the conduct of any of these members is not compliant with said Code of Ethics. Such investigations can be requested by any Registered Speedcubers, for whom the WEC is a confidant. This committee also functions as the board of appeal if anyone involved disagrees with a decision made by the WCA Disciplinary Committee.
<!-- break -->
**The qualities expected of candidates are:**
     - Clear background
     - Trustworthiness
     - Independence
     - Accountability

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until **September 4th, 2018, 23:59 UTC** to Walker Welch ([walkerewelch@gmail.com](mailto:walkerewelch@gmail.com)). The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and should include the following:**
     - Brief personal introduction
     - Summary of activities done for the WCA
     - Ambitions as a member of the WCA Ethics Committee.

Upon submission it will be confirmed if the document is in good order or if there are deficiencies.

More information on the WEC and the position can be found in [this document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/15cm2bkPIaPJe0Y1AXd87waRBnCom8Wa3e7FJBIL0Xdk/edit?usp=sharing). The rights and duties of the WEC can be seen in [WCA Motion 10.2017.8](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.8%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WEC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your interest in growing the WCA!

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会招募成员（2018 年 8 月）
translation.content:
WCA 道德委员会（WEC）正在招募合适的成员，共同完成委员会的工作！

**WEC 负责什么？**

WEC 负责确保 WCA 工作人员及外部工作人员遵守道德准则；若有关人员的行为不符合准则，则开展独立调查。任何注册速拧选手均可请求调查，WEC 会为他们保密处理相关事项。此外，若相关方不服 WCA 纪律委员会的决定，WEC 也作为申诉机构处理。
<!-- break -->
**我们希望申请人具备：**

- 背景清白。
- 值得信任。
- 能独立判断。
- 有责任心。

申请从即日起开放，请于 **2018 年 9 月 4 日 23:59 UTC** 前将材料发送给 Walker Welch（[walkerewelch@gmail.com](mailto:walkerewelch@gmail.com)）。所有人均可申请，无需目前在 WCA 任职。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 作为 WCA 道德委员会成员的工作设想。

提交后，我们会确认材料是否完整，或说明有哪些缺漏。

关于 WEC 和本岗位的更多信息见[此文档](https://docs.google.com/document/d/15cm2bkPIaPJe0Y1AXd87waRBnCom8Wa3e7FJBIL0Xdk/edit?usp=sharing)。WEC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2017.8](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.8%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WEC 负责人将作出选择，并在候选人接受岗位后公布新成员。

感谢你愿意帮助 WCA 发展！
